subject: POC prompt & log acquisition — ownership, guardrails, and transfer window
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@signalworks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-08T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC prompt & log acquisition — ownership, guardrails, and transfer window

Alex — thanks for an efficient call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the POC data handoff so we can finalize the evaluation plan:

- Success criteria (as discussed):
  - 90% intent-match on top-1 responses for the 1k prompt sample (measured by SignalWorks human raters).
  - Latency <= 200ms p50 and < 500ms p95 on typical 512-token runs using our Dedicated small pool.
  - No PII exfil detected in 30-day synthetic audit (our monitoring).

- What we need from SignalWorks:
  1) A representative prompt set (CSV) — recommended format: prompt_id, prompt_text, expected_label(optional), category.
  2) A small sample of historical logs (anonymized) or redaction rules if logs cannot leave your environment.
  3) Contact and owner for data transfer (S3 or temporary share).

- Timeline proposal:
  - By 2026-05-12: SignalWorks shares prompt CSV + one-week log sample OR approves redaction plan.
  - 2026-05-14 to 2026-05-21: Redwood ingests prompts, builds eval harness, initial run and baseline report.
  - 2026-05-25: Joint review of results and definition of canary success for a 2-week trial.

Ben and Lauren — please see notes for ownership (Ben: ingestion + infra; Lauren: eval metrics & report).

Attachments: prompt_sample.csv (example layout).

Thanks,
Vivek
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@signalworks.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@signalworks.com>
Date: 2026-05-09T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC prompt & log acquisition — ownership, guardrails, and transfer window

Thanks Vivek — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We confirm the success criteria above but want the human rater instructions shared before you run the baseline so we can align labels.
- Logs: we can provide a one-week anonymized request/response set but we need to remove user identifiers. Priya (cc) will own the redaction.
- For legal reasons we prefer to use our S3 bucket and grant temporary read-only access. Is that acceptable?

We can hit the 2026-05-12 window if you can send the exact CSV template and the HubSpot link for the intake ticket.

Alex
Head of ML Ops — SignalWorks

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@signalworks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya@signalworks.com>
Date: 2026-05-09T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC prompt & log acquisition — ownership, guardrails, and transfer window

Perfect — agree on the rater instructions. I'm attaching a lightweight CSV example and an internal checklist for anonymization. High level comments:

- Rater instructions: we will share the rubric (intent match, acceptable response, severity). We'll mark the rubric as "draft" so SignalWorks can comment before we run anything.
- S3 transfer: read-only access to your bucket is fine. Ben, can you provide a short doc with required IAM policy and an intake link?
- Security: we will only store the sample in an encrypted, short-lived bucket for ingestion and delete after the baseline run (we'll provide audit logs).

Attaching: prompt_sample.csv; anonymization_checklist.txt (see attachments).

Vivek

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@signalworks.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya@signalworks.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T08:55:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: S3 transfer instructions + minimal IAM policy

Forwarding the S3 transfer note and the minimal IAM snippet you can apply. Quick highlights:

- Create an IAM role with read-only get/list for the specific prefix. Example policy attached in s3_transfer_instructions.pdf.
- Provide a short-lived STS role or pre-signed URLs (we can accept either; STS role preferred for auditability).
- Once we confirm receipt we will run ingestion inside our secured project and then delete objects within 48 hours. Audit log link will be shared here.

Quoted message below.

--- Forwarded message ---
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: alex.johnson@signalworks.com
Date: 2026-05-10T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: S3 transfer instructions + minimal IAM policy

Alex — attaching the PDF. If you prefer a temporary presigned URL we can create that from our side; let us know which prefix you want to use.

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@signalworks.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@signalworks.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC prompt & log acquisition — ownership, guardrails, and transfer window

Thanks everyone — Priya has applied the redaction pipeline and created an s3 prefix: s3://signalworks-pocs/redwood/2026-05-sample.

We granted an IAM role (redwood-readonly-poc) limited to that prefix; please confirm when you can access it. I attached a small sample (5 prompts) in the same prefix for you to validate the template.

Next steps from SignalWorks:
- We will provide the full 1k prompt CSV by EOD 2026-05-12 (uploading to the same prefix).
- We'll expect the draft rater rubric before you run the baseline.

Alex
